ALPHA GUIDE 
Page 14 of 76 
 
Was Jesus fully human? 
• He had a human body. 
– tired (John 4:6) 
– hungry (Matthew 4:2) 
 
• He had human emotions.  
– anger (Mark 11:15–17) 
– love (Mark 10:21)– sadness (John 11:32–36) 
 
 
• He had human experiences. – Temptation (Mark 1:13) 
– learning (Luke 2:46–52) 
– work (Mark 6:3) 
– obedience (Luke 2:51) 
 
Was He more than a man, a great human, a religious teacher?   
Matthew 16:13–16)
